topics.title: Introduction: the short story as a form

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the basic elements of a short story: plot, point of view and mode.
Distinguish the story of incident, the story of character and a story that works through form.
Explain how the short story differs from the novel in magnitude and economy.

topics.title: The opening: Iona and his horse in the twilight snow

concepts.learning_objective: Interpret how the snowy twilight setting prepares the reader for Iona's grief.
Explain the images used to describe the motionless Iona and his little horse.

topics.title: Iona's fares: the officer and the three young men

concepts.learning_objective: Analyse how the officer and the three young men respond to Iona's grief.
Describe Iona's repeated attempts to tell his passengers about his son's death.

topics.title: Alone with grief: the street, the stable and the horse

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the narrator's description of Iona's immense grief that no one notices.
Evaluate the significance of Iona finally telling his story to his horse.

topics.title: Chekhov, theme and language of the story

concepts.learning_objective: State facts about Chekhov and the theme of failed human communication in his stories.
Interpret words and expressions from the story, such as 'as if he were on needles' and 'snuffle'.
